title: Type Guards
description: Learn how to narrow types with type guards.

data.text: **Type guards** are expressions that narrow the type of a variable. They help TypeScript understand what type a value is at runtime.

data.text: Type guards work best with discriminated unions - types that share a common property (like 'type') used to distinguish them.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Type guards help TypeScript understand runtime types.
